lines.1: A clear, dignified voice called out from behind us.
lines.3: But we did not look back.
lines.4: We could not let her see our faces.
lines.8: Crab took off at a furious sprint.
lines.9: Right. With this kind of offense, it probably would not be a major problem unless she caught us in the act.
lines.10: Letting her chew us out would be stupid.
lines.12: The four of us broke into a run.
lines.13: 「Stop. If you do not, I will impose punishment.」
lines.15: 「Only an idiot stops because someone tells them to!」
lines.16: 「I may not be good at much, but I know I can run!」
lines.18: 「I conclude that you have no intention of heeding my warning.」
lines.20: Her angry words carried from far behind us.
lines.21: But we had opened plenty of distance. What could she possibly do...?
lines.22: We were still running, after all.
lines.23: 「We're almost at the school gate! The road splits a bunch of ways there!」
lines.25: The instant everyone eased their pace...
lines.28: With a sickening crack, Fukahire rose into the air.
lines.29: Or rather, someone had swept his legs out from under him and sent him flying.
lines.30: The person whose kick had taken Fukahire's legs out was a girl.
lines.31: I knew at once that she belonged to the voice from earlier.
lines.32: That dignified voice and those unbelievable moves...
lines.33: There was no question it was her.
lines.39: Crab and I could not believe our eyes.
lines.40: Her spear-hand strike had buried itself in Subaru's stomach.
lines.42: He might be an idiot, but that guy was insanely good in a fight...
lines.47: Crab was hurled through the air and slammed into the ground.
lines.48: Even getting beaten, she never shut up.
lines.52: There was a sound like a fastball slamming into a catcher's mitt.
lines.53: At the same instant, a tremendous impact tore through my right leg.
lines.54: A low kick? Had I just taken a low kick?
lines.55: My leg hummed with numbness, and I could not stand.
lines.56: I collapsed into a sitting position right where I was.
